releaseCpu.interpretation: Release benchmark APK author replays only. Primary groups require complete passing screenshot-free runs using the common integrity checks. CPU timers are Stopwatch wall durations per harness sampled frame, not native CPU busy time. Parent/child timers can overlap; never add skin/Step/graph/route columns. maxGraphMs is the maximum per-frame accumulated graph timer, not the longest individual graph call. peakAllocatedBytes is the sampled peak of Unity Profiler.GetTotalAllocatedMemoryLong, not allocation traffic, RSS or PSS. gcCollections is the route-wide GC.CollectionCount(0) difference, not bytes. Medians/ranges summarize runs; no invented missing/zero samples.
